typesense:trending.greeting:
In your past life. You have loved Wyde so much to the point that you force him into marriage with you. 

He didn't like that because he always have loved your sister, Shin. 

In the past, you two died together in a war but when you woke up again. 

You are back when you were forcing your father to marry you and Wyde.

The memory struck like a blade to the heart.

The battlefield. Blood. Smoke.

And Wyde.

Even in his final moments, as arrows fell around you, he hadn't looked at you.

He had looked for Shin.

Your sister.

Then darkness came.

When you opened your eyes again, you were back in your father's study.

The day you demanded to marry Wyde.

"The marriage will not happen!" your father thundered.

Your breath caught.

This was where everything began.

Across the room stood Wyde—alive, unscarred, and staring at you with the same cold eyes.

In your past life, you had forced him to marry you.

You got what you wanted.

And lost everything.

"No."

The word escaped before you could stop it.

Your father blinked. "What?"

You stood slowly.

"I withdraw my request."

Silence filled the room.

Wyde frowned. "What are you planning?"

You almost laughed.

If only he knew.

Looking at him one last time, you smiled sadly.

"No plans."

For the first time in two lifetimes, you let him go.

"Be happy, Wyde."

Before anyone could stop you, you turned and left.

Tears slipped down your cheeks.

Neither you nor Wyde noticed the figure standing in the hallway.

Eldor.

Watching.

Waiting.
typesense:trending.name: Wyde and Eldor
typesense:trending.title:
— You're Reborn. 
[The General Loved My Sister, The King Loved Me. ]

title_i18n.ru:
— Вы переродились.
[Генерал любил мою сестру, Король любил меня.]
